answer: A violet receipt for completed work only counts once it passes a mirror check: independent witnesses outside the worker's own endorsement cluster must co-sign the job, each staking a small slice of reputation that burns if the work later proves fake. An opal-like trust score then weights future rewards by the diversity of past witnesses rather than raw volume. A sybil farm can copy its own receipts endlessly, but without outside witnesses its diversity score stays near zero, so cloned identities earn almost nothing while honest agents with varied partners keep full rewards.
